-->
<template>
	<AsamTree
		style="max-width: 600px"
		:allow-drop="allowDrop"
		:allow-drag="allowDrag"
		:data="data"
		draggable
		default-expand-all
		node-key="id"
		@node-drag-start="handleDragStart"
		@node-drag-enter="handleDragEnter"
		@node-drag-leave="handleDragLeave"
		@node-drag-over="handleDragOver"
		@node-drag-end="handleDragEnd"
		@node-drop="handleDrop"
	/>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/draggable.vue

import type {
	AsamTreeAllowDropType,
	AsamTreeNodeDropType,
	AsamTreeRenderContentContext
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

type Node = AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'];

const handleDragStart = (node: Node, _event: DragEvent) => {
	console.log('drag start', node);
};
const handleDragEnter = (draggingNode: Node, dropNode: Node, _event: DragEvent) => {
	console.log('tree drag enter:', dropNode.label);
};
const handleDragLeave = (draggingNode: Node, dropNode: Node, _event: DragEvent) => {
	console.log('tree drag leave:', dropNode.label);
};
const handleDragOver = (draggingNode: Node, dropNode: Node, _event: DragEvent) => {
	console.log('tree drag over:', dropNode.label);
};
const handleDragEnd = (
	draggingNode: Node,
	dropNode: Node | null,
	dropType: AsamTreeNodeDropType,
	_event: DragEvent
) => {
	console.log('tree drag end:', dropNode && dropNode.label, dropType);
};
const handleDrop = (
	draggingNode: Node,
	dropNode: Node,
	dropType: Exclude<AsamTreeNodeDropType, 'none'>,
	_event: DragEvent
) => {
	console.log('tree drop:', dropNode.label, dropType);
};
const allowDrop = (draggingNode: Node, dropNode: Node, type: AsamTreeAllowDropType) => {
	if (dropNode.data.label === '二级节点 3-1') {
		return type !== 'inner';
	} else {
		return true;
	}
};
const allowDrag = (draggingNode: Node) => {
	return !draggingNode.data.label.includes('三级节点 3-1-1');
};

const data = [
	{
		label: '一级节点 1',
		children: [
			{
				label: '二级节点 1-1',
				children: [
					{
						label: '三级节点 1-1-1'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	},
	{
		label: '一级节点 2',
		children: [
			{
				label: '二级节点 2-1',
				children: [
					{
						label: '三级节点 2-1-1'
					}
				]
			},
			{
				label: '二级节点 2-2',
				children: [
					{
						label: '三级节点 2-2-1'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	},
	{
		label: '一级节点 3',
		children: [
			{
				label: '二级节点 3-1',
				children: [
					{
						label: '三级节点 3-1-1'
					}
				]
			},
			{
				label: '二级节点 3-2',
				children: [
					{
						label: '三级节点 3-2-1'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	}
];
</script>
